resources.string: SATYA reads the screen only when you triple-tap its edge strip or tap the Check screen tile, to compare what a message asks for with your bank\'s published promises. It also watches WhatsApp and apps it has flagged as suspicious for requests your bank never makes. Your name and number are masked on this phone before anything leaves it. Nothing is read or sent in the background.
A message, call or app asked for something your bank never asks for.
